title: Collection Tabs
wikitext:
{{TOC|align=right}}
The '''Collections''' tab acts like a record of which items have been discovered or [[Stardew:Shipping|shipped]] that count towards the [[Stardew:Perfection|Perfection score]].

==Artifacts==
This tab keeps track of the various [[Artifacts]] donated to the [[Stardew:Museum|Museum]]. Artifacts do not need to be shipped to count toward completion.

''Hover over & click on an individual sprite to go directly to that page.''
